coach_says: TSB is at -55.5, Garmin status is UNPRODUCTIVE and resting HR is trending upward, so this is a mandated recovery week with only one quality session — your non-negotiable Tuesday MTB group ride. All other days are easy aerobic work or rest to shed fatigue, and gym is replaced with mobility to protect recovery. The goal is to return next week with a positive freshness trend so we can address the aerobic-high shortage with proper threshold work.

days.details: 30 min gentle yoga flow at lunch. Focus: hips, hamstrings, thoracic spine, deep breathing. Objective: active recovery and parasympathetic activation ahead of Tuesday's hard ride. No loading, no strain.

90 min | Objective: Committed group session — the single quality session of this recovery week
15 min Zone 1-2 easy warm-up spin before the group rolls out
Ride as the group dictates, but avoid unnecessary surges beyond what the trail demands
10 min Zone 1 easy spin to finish
Eat and hydrate immediately afterwards — recovery from this session is the week's priority. Skip any hard morning road ride today; keep the morning free or an easy 20 min spin at most.
Complete rest — mandatory recovery from Tuesday. Prioritise 8+ hours sleep, hydration and nutrition. Optional 10-15 min gentle walk or stretching only if you feel the need to move.

Warmup: 200m easy freestyle
Main: 4x100m easy freestyle, relaxed technique focus, 20 sec rest
Cooldown: 100m easy backstroke or freestyle
Total: ~700m
Objective: low-impact active recovery, keep effort conversational throughout.

90 min | Objective: Easy aerobic endurance (recovery week volume — capped deliberately)
90 min steady Zone 1-2, strictly below 75% max HR
Flat or rolling terrain, high cadence 90+ rpm, no surges or hills at effort
If legs feel heavy, cut to 60 min without hesitation.
60 min relaxed walk or gentle hike. Objective: active recovery, time on feet, variety. Conversational pace, no steep sustained climbs. Optional to shorten or swap for yoga if fatigue persists.

90 min | Objective: Aerobic maintenance at strictly easy intensity
90 min continuous Zone 2, nose-breathing / conversational effort
Smooth pedalling, cadence 85-95 rpm, avoid all hard efforts
This closes a genuine recovery week — if HRV and resting HR have improved by next week, we reintroduce threshold work to address the aerobic-high shortage.
